items.title: cfta: verified constrained EGraph.extract failure; repair pending

content.text:
[2026-10-27 03:03 CET] Verified against integrated main c168a952d779a72294c34d9c8fd5afd0e308c5ab, now pushed on formalize at 91fb8a9e751a0caa9df969b870a9c1ada5b3ecb9.

New constrained EGraph.extract defect: merge g(a) and h(b) into C; add p[C,b] with path equality [0,0]=[1]. Cost h is 2+sum(child costs), every other symbol 1+sum. This cost is both monotone and strictly greater than each child. Actual extract returns Nothing; actual termsByCost returns p(h(b),b) at cost 5; actual classAutomaton accepts that term (Right True). extract builds only unconstrained cheapest children, rejects p(g(a),b), and never tries the more expensive valid child. All 341 existing core examples pass. The current extraction generator has plain terms and misses this case.

Repair is PENDING. Do not blindly delegate extract to termsByCost: the latter requires child-cost monotonicity, beyond extract's current documented strict-child condition. Preserve this exact regression and settle sufficient cost admission for the repair. No runtime repair or test-suite change was applied.

Full handoff: FINDINGS.md, Verified constrained EGraph.extract failure after main integration. Runnable source: lean/restart-evidence/20261027-recursive-rendering/extract-constrained-repro.hs. Exact decoded native output is 71 bytes, SHA256 5ba63849d82a51db3bb8b99e7cc5c038d2f4c7d948704f67afec7b4ac70d80af. The evidence manifest is d96049e993a2f59d296203657d4d84d0e500b57fc0745dccc837bcd00a025ff4.

Separate proof result: six new strict modules connect actual diagonal captured completion and native rendering. Under explicit current admission, initial Canonical/Stratified, no-terminal/fresh-arity/child-retention/Ranges gates, structurally discharged final cache, actual successful render and checked returned residuals, the rendered term belongs to the original edge and parent and satisfies its old suspended constraints. The proof constructs the assignment; final Satisfies/Safe/order are not inputs. This remains local. H6 is unchanged; whole recursive output soundness, completeness and full Haskell correspondence remain open. Audit checks 78052 theorem dependencies. Core 341/0, Specftacular library/CLI build and changed formatting checks pass in Nix.

Upstream also changed union-find to direct parents plus root member IntSets. Existing Lean models path compression, so exact returned-forest correspondence needs a new representation relation. No valid-input native UF defect was found. Restart note: lean/notes-current-pruning-native-rendering.md.

Repair open as TharkunAB/cfta#182 (branch fix/egraph-extract-constraints, commit f961332e5 on main c168a952d). extract is now the first term of termsByCost, which checks each complete term at the e-node that built it. The cost contract of extract adds monotonicity in child costs (the old algorithm needed it too); strict increase above each child stays. extract does not return when the constraints reject each term of an infinite language; the haddock states this. Your reproducer is a regression test in EGraphSpec; the tautological termsByCost-vs-extract cost property is removed. cfta unit tests: 341 examples, 0 failures. The reproducer now prints Just (5, p(h(b), b)), [(5, p(h(b), b))], Right True.

[2026-10-27 03:20 CET] Verified the open, unmerged PR #182 at exact head f961332e59eb5a06fa151a7cf3647232b6ebd05b against base c168a952d779a72294c34d9c8fd5afd0e308c5ab. The actual diff delegates extract to listToMaybe (termsByCost ...), adds child-cost monotonicity and the infinite rejected-language nontermination caveat, adds the constrained regression and removes the tautological property. This formalize checkout has not merged that open PR or rerun its reported tests. FINDINGS will retain the live-base failure and mark the external repair as PR open.

Separate union-find progress: local source commits 9dfc776e8d8af30b3dcbf4229f46a374275ad476 and 75c3a79613f36597c57c22889e3680f6a8adc90e add four strict Lean modules for the new direct-parent/member-set backend. Initialization and every finite union history preserve complete duplicate-free class sets and stored cardinalities. The new model and every successful corresponding earlier union agree on exact representative names and sizes, including weighted ties and missing singleton roots. Their permitted assignments are exactly the requested equality equations. Old and new final map shapes are deliberately not equated.

Full Audit passes 3982 jobs and 78124 theorem dependency checks. Installed readback has 28 new public theorems, unchanged H6 and 18 complete definitions. A focused current Haskell/Nix comparison matches 88 representative reads and the final size-7 member set; all finds retain their original forests. Full enumeration-state/CPS transport, concrete IntMap/IntSet extraction and machine Int bounds remain open. H6 and the local captured rendering theorem are unchanged. No Haskell runtime change was made. Evidence and restart docs are being prepared for the authorized formalize push.
